item.title: High-pressure setup unlocks detailed measurements of organized structures in turbulent flows
item.description: Turbulent flows are ubiquitous: they are found in clouds, in the ocean and even on other planets. For example, while long streaks of clouds may appear orderly from the outside, their interiors are characterized by intense turbulence. Fuente: Phys.org.
